findings.summary: Possible race: without a lock, a threaded purge_job can race with revoke/create, so `del self._by_token[session.token]` may raise KeyError and abort the purge partway; add a lock or use pop(token, None).

judge.reason: Describes the known lack of locking/race in the store, which is a listed pre-existing problem.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: `self._items.remove(session)` is O(n) on every logout, which may be slow with many live sessions; an insertion-ordered dict keyed by token would avoid this.

judge.reason: Matches the known O(n) _items.remove in revoke.

findings.label: valid_other
